messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, Elections, and Economic systems and development in Germany during the 1990s, matching this research need: daily representative telephone omnibus survey data of eligible voters since 1991 on political attitudes, party and candidate preferences, and past voting behavior in elections
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
